I used an open source dataset, the Chinese Name Database 1930-2008, to examine the most popular Chinese surnames.

I also created a custom search box where you can input your Chinese surname to learn:

1.  Where your surname ranks out of 1,806 characters

2.  How many people share your Chinese surname

You can find the search box hosted [here](https://jesseperegrino.github.io/chinese-name-search-box/).

[**Technologies**]{.underline}: R/RStudio, Inkscape, Javascript, Treemap Graph, Lollipop Graph, ChineseNames R package
